_doc: Scenery props (Oathwild 2026-11-23): static, unrigged, one painted texture each. Each sheet = one Codex 2x2 drawing (tools/refdraw.mjs <sheet id>) = one Trellis-2 job (tools/scenery.sh). Per object: kind, regions, real size in metres (h = height, or w = longest ground side when the object is long and low), tris = triangle target, tex = its own texture size in px, align = turn the footprint square to the axes (false for round things), yaw = extra turn in degrees after looking. Built files: models/final/scenery/<id>.glb; measured triangles and sizes go to data/catalog.json (scenery).

objects.name: Thatched cottage
objects.look: small one-storey farm cottage: white plaster walls with dark oak timber framing, thick golden thatched roof with rounded edges, a stone chimney, one wooden plank door on the front, two small shuttered windows, a low stone footing

objects.name: Stone cottage
objects.look: small one-storey cottage of rough grey fieldstone with a steep blue-grey slate roof, a chunky stone chimney at one end, a green-painted wooden door with an iron ring, one small window with a flower box

objects.name: Log cabin
objects.look: woodsman's log cabin of thick round brown logs with crossed log ends at the corners, a mossy wooden shingle roof, a small covered porch with two posts over the front door, a stone chimney on the side

objects.name: Village inn
objects.look: two-storey village inn and longhouse: stone ground floor, timber-framed cream plaster upper floor that juts out a little, long red-brown tiled roof, a big double door in the middle of the long front, a hanging painted wooden sign on an iron bracket showing a golden goose, warm yellow windows

objects.name: Smithy
objects.look: village smithy: an open-sided timber workshop with a sloping wooden shingle roof on thick posts, a big stone forge with a tall brick chimney at the back, a glowing orange coal bed, a water barrel and hanging tongs and horseshoes on the back wall

objects.name: Watermill
objects.look: village watermill: a tall stone-and-timber mill house with a thatched roof and a big wooden waterwheel with paddles fixed to one side wall, a small wooden sluice trough above the wheel

objects.name: Watchtower
objects.look: tall square wooden watchtower on four thick log legs with cross bracing, a ladder up the front, a railed lookout platform at the top under a small pointed shingle roof, a red pennant on top

objects.name: Village well
objects.look: round village well: a ring of grey stones, two wooden posts holding a small pointed shingle roof, a winch handle and a rope with a wooden bucket

objects.name: Palisade wall
objects.look: one straight section of a wooden palisade wall: a row of seven sharpened upright logs of the same height, bound with two horizontal rope-tied cross beams, seen from the front-left

objects.name: Palisade corner
objects.look: a palisade corner post: a thick round log tower post, taller than the wall, with a sharpened top and iron bands, and two short stubs of sharpened-log wall leaving it at a right angle

objects.name: Palisade gate
objects.look: a palisade gate: two tall log gate towers joined by a log beam overhead, a pair of closed heavy plank gate doors with iron studs between them, sharpened log tips on top

objects.name: Rail fence
objects.look: one straight section of a rustic split-rail farm fence: three rough wooden posts and two long split rails between them

objects.name: Market stall
objects.look: village market stall: a wooden counter table with a red-and-cream striped cloth awning on four posts, baskets of apples, cabbages and loaves on the counter

objects.name: Hand cart
objects.look: a two-wheeled wooden farm cart with big spoked wheels, plank sides and two long handles resting on the ground at the front, a few sacks inside

objects.name: Haystack
objects.look: a round dome haystack of golden straw with a rope net over it

objects.name: Signpost
objects.look: a wooden crossroads signpost: one tall post with three blank painted arrow-shaped plank signs pointing different ways, a small pointed cap on top, no writing

objects.name: Lamp post
objects.look: a village lamp post: a dark wooden post with a curled iron arm at the top holding a hanging square iron lantern with warm yellow glass

objects.name: Anvil
objects.look: a dark iron blacksmith anvil with a pointed horn, sitting on a thick tree-stump block bound with an iron hoop, a hammer resting on top

objects.name: Low stone wall
objects.look: one straight section of a low dry-stone field wall made of stacked rounded grey stones with a few tufts of moss, knee to waist high

objects.name: Wood pile
objects.look: a neat stack of split firewood logs, round ends showing pale wood rings, with an axe stuck in a chopping block beside it

objects.name: Barrel
objects.look: a single closed wooden barrel with two dark iron hoops, warm brown staves

objects.name: Crate
objects.look: a single closed wooden shipping crate of light planks with darker cross braces and nailed corners, a cube
objects.note: Trellis built it as an open lattice (no plank panels): redraw as a solid box when credit is back.

objects.name: Grain sacks
objects.look: a pile of three plump tied burlap grain sacks leaning on each other
objects.note: Made from the decimation_target 5000 test job (scn-sc-clutter-d5000): closed sacks with their tied necks.

objects.name: Weapon rack
objects.look: a wooden weapon rack holding two spears, a sword and a round wooden shield leaning against it
objects.note: Thin poles: kept on the maker's own 5000-target surface (no remesh).

objects.name: Bedroll
objects.look: an unrolled sleeping bedroll lying flat: a brown wool blanket on a fur, with a rolled-up end as a pillow, seen from above-front

objects.name: Campfire
objects.look: a campfire: a ring of grey stones around crossed half-burnt logs with a few bright orange coals and short stylized orange flames

objects.name: Small tent
objects.look: a small A-frame canvas tent of patched tan cloth over a wooden ridge pole, guy ropes to wooden pegs, front flap open

objects.name: Chief's tent
objects.look: a large round bandit chief's tent of dark red and brown patched canvas on a central pole, wooden poles sticking out of the top, animal furs draped at the open entrance, a small skull charm hanging by the door

objects.name: Bandit banner
objects.look: a crude tall banner on a wooden pole with a crossbar: a ragged black cloth painted with a red slashed circle emblem, torn at the bottom

objects.name: Village banner
objects.look: a tall banner on a wooden pole with a crossbar: a clean sky-blue cloth with a white wavy river emblem and a golden fringed bottom edge

objects.name: Wooden chest
objects.look: a plain closed wooden treasure chest with a rounded lid, brown planks and simple dark iron bands and a small iron lock plate

objects.name: Iron-bound chest
objects.look: a sturdy closed treasure chest of dark stained wood heavily bound with riveted steel bands and corner plates, a big round steel lock, a blue cloth tassel hanging from the lock

objects.name: Gilded chest
objects.look: an ornate closed royal treasure chest: deep purple painted wood, polished gold corner pieces, gold filigree bands and a large gold lock with a red gem, little gold feet

objects.name: Loot bag
objects.look: a plump leather loot bag tied at the neck with a cord, a few gold coins spilling from a fold at its base

objects.name: Crate stack
objects.look: a stack of three wooden crates: two side by side at the bottom and one on top, slightly turned

objects.name: Water barrel
objects.look: an open-topped wooden rain barrel full to the top with blue water, iron hoops, a wooden ladle hooked over the rim

objects.name: Wooden bridge
objects.look: a straight wooden footbridge seen from the front-left along its length: a gently arched plank deck on log trestle legs at both ends and the middle, simple log handrails on both sides

objects.name: Stone bridge
objects.look: a sturdy old grey stone bridge with one big round arch underneath, low stone parapet walls on both sides, moss on the stones, seen from the front-left along its length

objects.name: Road marker
objects.look: a short square milestone of grey stone with a rounded top and a carved arrow and three notches on its face, moss at its foot

objects.name: Waystone
objects.look: a fast-travel waystone: a tall upright slab of dark blue-grey stone on a round two-step stone base, a big carved spiral rune on its face glowing bright cyan-blue, small cyan crystals set in the top

objects.name: Shrine of return
objects.look: a small open roadside shrine where heroes return to life: four white stone pillars holding a little domed roof with a golden sun finial, a round white stone floor with three steps, a golden bowl on a pedestal in the centre holding a bright white-gold flame

objects.name: Standing stone
objects.look: a single tall rough standing stone, grey with lichen patches, slightly leaning and tapering to the top

objects.name: Capped stones
objects.look: two rough grey standing stones side by side with a third long flat stone laid across their tops like a doorway, moss on the top

objects.name: Carved circle stone
objects.look: a tall standing stone carved with a green-painted leafy vine and spiral pattern on its face, ivy growing up one side, a garland of leaves hanging over the top

objects.name: Broken wall
objects.look: a ruined section of old pale stone castle wall, broken jagged top higher at one end, a few stones fallen at its foot, moss and ivy, an empty arched window hole

objects.name: Ruined arch
objects.look: a free-standing ruined stone archway of pale carved blocks, two square pillars and a pointed arch with one block missing, ivy hanging from it

objects.name: Broken pillar
objects.look: a broken round fluted stone column on a square base, its top snapped off at an angle, cracks and moss

objects.name: Tower stump
objects.look: the round lower part of a ruined stone watchtower: a thick circular wall with a broken jagged top, an arched doorway, a few arrow slits, grass and ivy growing on the stones

objects.name: Barrow entrance
objects.look: the entrance of an ancient burial mound: a grassy earth mound with a doorway framed by three huge rough stones (two uprights and a lintel), a dark opening, carved spirals on the lintel, a few small stones around

objects.name: Sarcophagus
objects.look: a long grey stone coffin with a heavy lid carved as a sleeping armoured king with a sword on his chest, cracked corner, cobwebs

objects.name: Old gravestone
objects.look: an old upright gravestone of grey stone with a rounded top, tilted a little, worn blank face, moss on top

objects.name: Ringed grave marker
objects.look: a tall old stone grave marker shaped as an upright post with a stone ring around its top, weathered and cracked

objects.name: Sunken slab
objects.look: a thick square grave slab leaning crooked, half sunk, with a broken corner and lichen

objects.name: Grave railing
objects.look: one straight section of rusty black wrought-iron graveyard railing with spear-tipped bars and two square posts

objects.name: Broken statue
objects.look: a weathered stone statue of a robed figure holding a lantern, its head broken off, standing on a cracked square plinth, moss on the shoulders

objects.name: Rubble pile
objects.look: a low pile of broken pale stone blocks and fallen masonry chunks with weeds

objects.name: Small rock
objects.look: a small chunky grey rock with flat painted facets

objects.name: Medium rock
objects.look: a medium angular grey rock with a mossy green top

objects.name: Large rock
objects.look: a large blocky grey rock with sharp flat faces and a little moss

objects.name: Boulder
objects.look: a big round weathered boulder, warm grey-brown, smooth with a few cracks

objects.name: Rock cluster
objects.look: a cluster of five small grey pebbles and stones grouped together

objects.name: Flat slab
objects.look: a wide flat low grey rock slab, like a stepping table, with cracks

objects.name: Cliff chunk
objects.look: a tall chunk of cliff face: layered grey-brown rock strata in big stepped blocks, a grassy green top edge, flat back

objects.name: Mossy boulder
objects.look: a rounded boulder almost covered by thick bright green moss with a few small ferns growing from it

objects.name: Oak
objects.look: a stylized broad oak tree: a thick short twisted brown trunk splitting into a few branches, a big round puffy crown of chunky clumped green leaf masses

objects.name: Old oak
objects.look: a stylized old wide oak tree with a gnarled trunk, visible roots at the base, and a broad flat-topped crown made of three big chunky leaf clumps in two greens

objects.name: Pine
objects.look: a stylized tall pine tree: a straight brown trunk and four stacked chunky cone-shaped tiers of dark green needles getting smaller to a point

objects.name: Spruce
objects.look: a stylized squat bushy spruce tree with drooping layered blue-green needle tiers and a little trunk showing at the bottom

objects.name: Birch
objects.look: a stylized slim birch tree: a thin white trunk with black bark marks, and a tall oval crown of chunky light yellow-green leaf clumps

objects.name: Willow
objects.look: a stylized weeping willow: a thick leaning trunk and a dome crown whose long chunky curtains of green leaves hang down almost to the ground

objects.name: Marsh tree
objects.look: a stylized twisted swamp tree standing on tall arching roots like stilts, a crooked dark grey-brown trunk, a sparse flat crown of murky olive-green leaf clumps and hanging grey moss strands

objects.name: Dead tree
objects.look: a stylized dead leafless tree: a pale grey twisted trunk with a few thick crooked bare branches reaching up, a split at the top

objects.name: Tree stump

objects.name: Broken stump
objects.look: a tall broken tree stump with a jagged splintered top, mossy bark, a small mushroom on its side

objects.name: Fallen log

objects.name: Hollow log

objects.name: Mushroom clump

objects.name: Giant toadstool

objects.name: Reeds

objects.name: Bog lilies

objects.name: Round bush
objects.look: a round chunky green shrub made of a few clumped leaf masses

objects.name: Berry bush
objects.look: a round dark green bush dotted with clusters of red berries

objects.name: Bramble
objects.look: a wide low tangle of thorny brown bramble stems with sparse dark leaves

objects.name: Fern
objects.look: a big leafy fern clump with broad arching green fronds spreading out from the middle

objects.name: Goblin hut

objects.name: Goblin totem

objects.name: Spike barricade

objects.name: Scrap heap

objects.name: Wheelbarrow

objects.name: Water trough

objects.name: Pumpkin patch

objects.name: Scarecrow
objects.look: a harmless field scarecrow on a wooden cross post: a burlap sack head with a stitched smile and a floppy straw hat, a patched blue shirt on the crossbar arms, straw sticking out

objects.look: a crooked swamp hut on tall wooden stilts: a small leaning plank house with a sagging mossy thatched roof, a rickety ladder up to the door, hanging bones, bottles and dried herbs, a crooked chimney

objects.name: Boardwalk

objects.name: Rowboat

objects.name: Drying rack

objects.name: Lookout platform
objects.look: a crude bandit lookout platform: a small square plank deck on four rough log legs with diagonal braces, a ladder, a low rail of sticks and a ragged cloth sunshade

objects.name: Prisoner cage
objects.look: an empty square wooden prisoner cage of lashed vertical poles with a plank roof and a rope-tied door

objects.name: Stolen goods
objects.look: a heap of stolen goods: an open small chest with gold coins, a rolled rug, two sacks, a silver candlestick and a jug

objects.name: Notice board
objects.look: a village notice board: a small plank board on two posts with a little pointed roof, several blank paper notes pinned on it, no writing

objects.name: Circle altar
objects.look: a low flat stone altar table on two thick stone legs, a green leaf garland and a wooden bowl of berries on top, carved spirals on the front

objects.name: Antler totem

objects.name: Wicker stag

objects.name: Moon pool
objects.look: a small round pool ringed by mossy flat stones, its water a calm pale blue-silver, a few lily pads
